fixes.explanation: Offerings never come up in this verse, friend. David doesn't ask who has the fattest offering. He asks God to save by His right hand “…those who seek refuge from their foes.” (Psalm 17:7) I think that's good news for anybody showing up with empty hands, because the only thing this verse asks you to bring is yourself, running for cover.

I love the optimism, friend, but nobody in this verse is scheduling a sit-down over coffee. David prays, “Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees…” (Psalm 17:13) He's not asking for a handshake. He's asking God to step in and stop them. I think when David has run out of his own options, handing it to the LORD is the move.
